tagline: Where strength is the only law.
palette: charred earth #1a0808 base, fire orange #c44e2a accent, dried blood #732424 glow, ember air #2a0e08 atmosphere
motifs: Bone armor, ritual scarification, jagged volcanic rock, chains and brands, double-bladed weapons, lava cracks, banners of stretched hide. No fine craft — everything is hammered, broken, re-forged.
voice: Clipped, defiant, almost playful in its violence. Pose suggests violence held just short of release.

palette: abyss #06060c base, witness violet #6f4d8c accent, cold star #4fb0ff glow, deep stillness #0e0e1c atmosphere
motifs: Single eye motifs, tendrils that hover (never thrash), geometric crowns, glassine skin, jellyfish-pulse glow, asymmetric forms, floating tablets covered in spirals.
voice: Quiet, slow, polite. Pose suggests eternal patience.

motifs: Bone wraps and burial cloth, candle-lanterns hung from ribs, willow trees, slow water, masks of clay and moss, lichens on armor, broken sword-grave markers, slow-burn incense smoke.
voice: Tired, kind, ceremonial. Pose suggests gentle dignity.

voice: Direct, physical, present-tense. Pose suggests readiness to move.

voice: Calm, ritual, never-doubting. Pose suggests serene authority.

voice: Honest about appetite, sometimes wry. Pose suggests restrained hunger.

voice: Helpful, slightly literal. Pose suggests processing stance.

tagline: Where the first lives still live.

motifs: Coral crowns, mother-of-pearl scales, fins that double as sails, gills, kelp wraps, ancient bronze armor patinated green, tridents, shells the size of shields, jellyfish as lanterns, whale-bone rib temples.
voice: Slow, deep, generous. Pose suggests immovable patience.

tagline: Where the next horizon is the only horizon.

motifs: Star-map cloaks, comet-tail hair, helmets shaped like crescents, weapons that leave faint light trails, geometric crystal armor, wings of solid starfield, capes that fall like cosmic dust.
voice: Bold, forward-leaning, almost romantic. Pose suggests reaching outward.

tagline: Where the world remembers being born.

voice: Calm, ancient, slightly amused at the present. Pose suggests timeless knowledge.
